verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Brex serves an llms.txt at developer.brex.com (HTTP 200, with a 'Brex Developer API' table of contents), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. The developer docs are also published as .md pages, including MCP setup instructions an agent can follow. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (all probes 404), no evidence of an llms-full.txt or independent reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.brex.com/llms.txt # Brex Developer API
claude mcp add --transport http brex https://api.brex.com/mcp
